opportunities.point: Management expects EBITDA margins to reach closer to 14% to 15% in the next 3 years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So I think on a blended basis, we are confident that in the next 3 years or so, we should be closer to the 14% to 15% EBITDA margin with the share of value-added products increasing." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects EBITDA margins to reach approximately 14% with higher-value product offerings.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Margins as our CFO just mentioned, it would be approximately close to 14% EBITDA because stronger products are being developed, and over the last quarter, we've also invested, as we said, and come out with one or two new products, and another product is also..." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project is nearing completion with trial runs scheduled for next month.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Phase 1, comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000-plus metric tons facility, is nearing completion now with trial runs scheduled for next month." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is on track for commissioning in Q4 of '27 and is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "At Naidupeta, our brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in the Q4 of '27. The project is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons to our existing manufacturing capacity." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 8 Cr -> 12 Cr (50%) as of Sep 2026

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 11.8% earnings growth vs 24% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management noted strong demand across all customer end-user applications in Q3.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Even currently in Q3, we are witnessing strong demand across all our customer end-user applications, and we are confident of surpassing the numbers achieved till now." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Non-rubber applications accounted for over 18% of sales in the first half of 2027.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Non-rubber applications today account for over 18% of our sales in the first half of 2027, supported by expansion across ceramic, specialty chemicals, agriculture and pharmaceutical verticals." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: JGC has an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "As India's largest player in the industry with an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum, JGC is very well positioned to benefit from this consolidation trend going forward." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeded 80% during Q2.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "On the operational front, the company continued to deliver double-digit volume growth during Q2 with zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeding 80%." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.56 pp, DII -1.03 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted West Asia disruptions as part of the operating environment context for tyre exports.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production." (concall ppt - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: Geopolitical conflict impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the primary raw material.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)
